climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

notes: Naoussa is a red from Xinomavro.
Classic Naoussa has high acidity, medium color and savory aromas of tomato paste and olive.
Its tannins are firm and often aggressive, and need years of aging to soften.
Some sites give deeper color, softer tannins and riper, warmer fruit.
Aromas also take in red fruit, spice, dried plum, tobacco and nuts, and a complex bouquet forms with age.
Off-dry and medium-sweet versions are also made.

blurb.text: A PDO in Greek Macedonia for red wine made only from Xinomavro.
